text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year has begun. Starting today, Twin Turbo
is in the Senior Year, and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Hatsumodeee!
Let's go, Trainer, Nature, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Even in the Senior class,
Turbo hasn't changed a bit."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumode, huh. I'll need to pray with all my heart too.
I'm entering the Classic tier starting this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to go on the first shrine visit of the year,
bringing along our new friend, Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? That person over there is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Haaay, Teio!
Happy New Yea-aar!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Turbo and the others.
And Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio was also at the shrine where we went for Hatsumode.
From the looks of it, her leg seems to be completely fine now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Are you here for Hatsumode too?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yep! For good luck!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I worked pretty hard last year too,
but I want to achieve even better results this year.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Team Turbo's different this year!
'Cause we got a huge rookie on our side now!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Calling me a top rookie, really...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser herself
had already made a wish beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I hope good things happen this year too.
And as for Bourbon-san, who completely paid me
no attention when we ran before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANG-CLANG!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pow!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Bwaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uaaahhh, Turbooo, Natureee,
a bell fell on my faceee.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, a walking department store of misfortune, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Looks like another... intense bunch just joined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the introductions finished, Twin Turbo made
her wish once again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Dear gods, please, oh please...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I pray that I can run at full power from
start to finish this year!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed she would vow to 'defeat Teio,'
but... her wish was slightly different.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mm, staring at me... What's up, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Isn't your wish to defeat Tokai Teio?
Isn't your wish to beat Tokai Teio?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as long as Turbo burns completely bright,
I should be able to pull that off!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo ran with Trainer last year and grew a little bigger. And then, Turbo realized!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you always run like your life depends on it
and achieve complete victory over yourself,
you'll get the best result in any race!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's why Turbo's gonna blaze through
the whole year without thinking about anything!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"First, smash past our May goal!
Then at the end of the year, go all out in a major race!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna do it! Watch me do it, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo has no hesitation.
In that case, all I have to do is pave the road ahead
so she can sprint at full blast without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then today is a full-throttle practice run! Turbo wants to play with everything she's got!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should we do, what should we do?!
What game do you wanna play?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Full power for training, full power for play.
That's the Twin Turbo way.
So, what we're doing today is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Playing with dogs and cats? That sounds awesome!
Turbo wants to do it, she wants to do it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not scared at all!
'Cause I love Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo is timid at heart, but she seems fine around animals. For now, we headed to a nearby ranch famous for having lots of dogs and cats.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, a doggie! A kitty!
Turbo is gonna pet you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Doggie, doggieee!
Um, that one's name isn't "Dog."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That is Mr. Pugzawa Hermann.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Hey now, Machan. Stop giving it weird names. Plus, it's too long."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Puggy's fine, ain't it?
Right, Puggy?

text_block_list.name: Pug
text_block_list.text: (Woof!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, I believe it's Mr. Hermann Pugzawa, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Someone was already there: Miho Dorm Leader Hishi Amazon, and the gentle, whimsical Umamusume Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama, and Machan...
Why are you two here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, this ranch
takes in quite a few stray dogs and cats
that have nowhere else to go.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you know...
You just can't leave 'em alone,
stray cats and dogs like that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is why we are regulars there.
We often run into Hishi Ama-san, too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then Turbo's gonna start going from today!
I love dogs, cats, and chickens too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, we don't have any chickens, though.
Well, make yourself at home!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's all spend some relaxing time
together under one roof.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Turbo's relaxing at fuuuuull throttle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strange connection, an odd combination.
Yet somehow, Twin Turbo opened up to them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, under the same roof, they spent their time
lazing around and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Super hardcore gymnastics? Are we gonna
do gymnastics with all our might?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, awesome, let's do it! Let's do it!
Alright, let's head to the park over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, an unexpected visitor was already there.
Working out with a dead serious expression was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was Daiichi Ruby,
the young lady of the Glorious Family.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ruby?
What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —New Year preparations. Even though the year has just begun, we cannot afford to idle away in peace.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: At the very least—some light stretching.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then Turbo's gonna do it too!
Having a rival really fires me up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One, two! Three, four!
One, two! Three, four!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, pretty good moves, Ruby.
Turbo's not gonna lose to you, though!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Three, four! Three, four—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her competitive spirit ignited, she threw herself into a full-body workout.
As a result, both her body and mind were strengthened.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna shoot tons of videos?!
Sounds good! Turbo's great at editting, after all!
choice_data_list: Then I'll be the cameraman myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them decided to shoot a whole bunch of cinematic short films together.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together! Stay with me!
Just a little farther and we'll escape the zombie horde!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So get up! Get on your feet—!
choice_data_list: Don't worry about me... just run!
Don't worry about me... just run!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Got it! Turbo, full-power daaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, the ali-yuns are here!
The ali-yuns are attacking!
choice_data_list: Just run to the ends of the earth...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Got it! Turbo, full-power daaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what should we do next?
choice_data_list: Are we sticking with this series all day?
Are we going with this series all day?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's try out as many ideas
as we can come up with!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we shot a ton of getaway-style clips.
We managed to test out quite a few different patterns.
